item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect mostly clear skies with low temperatures ranging from the lower twenties to the upper twenties and no precipitation. Tomorrow brings partly to mostly cloudy conditions with high temperatures from the lower fifties to the mid-fifties and only a slight chance of rain. Looking ahead to tomorrow night, skies stay mostly clear or partly cloudy with lows in the upper thirties to lower forties and little to no precipitation expected.
